tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (da)༄༅/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug dza hā bhī ra'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru rat+na ya/mtha' yas dam chos nor bu'i mdzod bzung
(da)༄༅/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug dza hā bhī ra'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru rat+na ya/mtha' yas dam chos nor bu'i mdzod bzung

tei:div.tei:p: (da)༄༅// grub pa'i dbang phyug dza hā bhī ra'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa bzhugs// ༄༅// na mo gu ru rat+na ya/ mtha' yas dam chos nor bu'i mdzod bzung nas// skal ldan grub pa'i lam la 'god pa'i dpal// 'chi med brnyes pa 'gro ba'i mgon po yi// zhabs la btud nas gsang chen yi ger 'dri// gang zhig 'chi med bsgrub 'dod pas// rnam shes bzhon pa dbang du bya// de yi tshul yang bsam yas las// tshegs chung don che 'di nyid longs// rang nyid kun tu bzang por bsgom// nyi mar dbyung nas zla bar rngubs// keng rus gdan gyi 'dug stangs kyis//

kha ka ling ka nas drag por gsum// khong 'dar shin tu thon por dbyung*// ci bder 'dug pa'i rnal 'byor pas// bya lam nam mkhar za zhing drag por rngubs// ji srid lto ba ma khengs pa// de srid tshod dang sbyar zhing za// so ma lto ba sin+dhe ci bder bzhag /'gro bar brtsams na cung zad mnan// 'di ltar brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pa// nad kyi rnam pa kun byang zhing*// zag med bde ba rab rgyas nas// 'chi med go 'phang nges par thob// sgo bzhi bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang*// dgu phrugs 'phrul 'khor sbyor ba yis// ma dper 'go ba'i nad zer ba'ang 'dug kyang khrid kyi dgongs par mgo bo'i nad zer ba 'di ka yin mgo bo'i nad rnams kun byang nas// skra li nag cing 'khyil bar 'gyur// yun ring bsdams nas shugs drag par// mthong lam nas dbyung 'khrul 'khor bya// mig gi rab rib mtha' dag sel// de bzhin dbang po gzhan la'o// sgo dgu bkag pa'i bsam gtan dang*// rdo rje'i pad kor gar dang bcas dmigs bsal med pa'i glu// khro bos gang rung bgegs dpung nges 'joms pas// thun gyi thog ma mtha' mar bsgom// bh+rū rlung 'di nyid bdun phrag gsum// zas gzhan spangs te bsgom par bya// de nas rim gyis zla ba drug /bsgom na 'chi med 'grub bo gsungs// kho bo'i bla ma nub phyogs pa// 'di nyid zla ba drug bsgoms pas// me dang chu yis mi gnod pa'i// rdzu 'phrul mchog la mnga' brnyes gyur// kho bo blo zhan brtson 'grus dman// 'on kyang zhag bdun nyams blangs pas// yid ches ngo mtshar mang du byung*// de slad 'di ni don brgyud yin// sngon chad cha lag phra mo las// rdzogs par su la'ang bslabs pa med// da lam snod ldan gang zag la// sba bsri med par phul ba lags// yi ge med pa'i snyan brgyud 'di// dam pa'i zhal ngor 'dri snyam tshe// rmi lam nyams kyi snang ba la// bla mas yi ger bkod nas gnang*// de don tshang la ma nor bar// yi ger bkod pa'i dge ba yis// mkha' khyab 'gro kun chos kyi dbyings// kun tu bzang po mngon gyur shog

/ces pa chos rje mkhyen ldan grub pa'i dbang phyug stobs ldan 'od zer gyis bkas bskul nas/ rgyal khams kyi sprang po mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis bla ma'i gsung bzhin yi ger bris pa nyi zla ltar gyur cig /sarba dā maṅga laṃ/ 'di thams cad gcig tu dgos pa'i nges pa med pas/ gang dgos gcig byas la sngon 'gro dang rjes gang yang mi dgos so// ༈ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dza hā bhīr nas brgyud pa'i 'chi med bh+rū rlung gi gdams pa zab mo bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ḍā ki nī yai/ 'dir grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dza hā bhīr nas brgyud pa'i tshe sgrub zab mo nyams su blang bar 'dod pas nam mkha' sngo sang rgya che ba mthong ba'i sar stan bde la 'dug ste/ nyams su len rgyu ni/ dang por/ rang nyid mchan rnying pa zhig tu/ stong par bsgom pa yin gyi zhal phyag can med ces snang*/ kun tu bzang por bsgoms zhes pa'i don rang gi lus gnas khang lung pa yul phyogs thams cad mi dmigs par stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang kun tu bzang po sku mdog sngon po gcer bu rgyan med pa zhig bsams pa'i spyi bor mchan rnying du/ rang tha mal par gsal ba'i spyi bor zhes snang*/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma grub thob dza hā bhīr sku mdog smug nag sha rgyas shing brjid chags pa/ nyi ma bye ba'i 'od can/ gcer bu rgyan med zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i mthil sbyar ba'i mtheb chen gnyis rtse sprad pa rang gi tshangs bug tu zug pa/ phyag gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog bcings pa skyabs gnas kun 'dus su mos la/ rang gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib ltung ba nyes pa myong bar nges pa'i las sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ snyam pas lus ngag yid gsum 'jug pa gcig tu bsgril nas gsol ba 'di ltar 'debs so// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

dus gsum kun mkhyen pad+ma saṃ bha wa// grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba dza hā bhīr// dngos grub brnyes pa bh+ra ma nā tha la// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// snyan brgyud mdzod 'dzin ma ṇi nā ta dang*// nges par thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs// 'phags mchog byams pa skal ldan bzang po la// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// 'chi med grub brnyes dbang phyug rab brtan dang*// rdo rje 'chang dngos khyab bdag zhwa lu pa// ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sder// gsol ba= /rig 'dzin grub pa'i gtsug rgyan pad+ma'i mtshan// slob bshad 'dzin mkhas kun dga' blo gros dang*// rig 'dzin chen po phyogs las rnam rgyal zhabs// bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// sngon 'gro gsum gyis rang rgyud legs sbyangs nas// dngos gzhi stong pa rngubs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// tha mal snang ba'i sgrib pa kun byang nas// tshe 'dir mkha' spyod 'grub pa byin gyis rlobs// zhes brgya stong nas lan gsum yan chad brjod/ de nas lag g.yas pa'i thal mo smin mtshams su dengs byas nas/ na mas dza hā bhīr/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas bla ma dgyes shing 'dzum pas 'od zer dmar po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin snum pa/ 'tsher ba/ 'dril ba zhig tu gyur nas rang gi spyi bor thim pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs mkhyen brtse nus gsum dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du 'dres par bsams la phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du cung zhig bzhag de nas/ nyi mar dbyung nas zla bar rngubs// zhes pa'i don sna bug g.yon bkag la g.yas nas phyir nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khung nas du ba thon pa ltar song*/ nam mkha'i dbyings su yal bar bsams la rlung shugs bskyed de 'bud/ yang sna bug g.yas bkag la sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam sogs mdor na skyabs gnas yod do cog gi mthu stobs nus pa byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par byung*/

sna bug g.yon nas song*/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bar bsams la cung zhig rlung 'dzin/ yang sna bug g.yon bkag g.yas nas shugs bskyed de phyir 'bud pa sogs sngar ltar lan gsum song rjes/ keng rus gdan gyi 'dug stangs kyis// ka ling ka nas drag por gsum// khong 'dar shin tu thon par dbyung*// zhes pa'i mchan rnying du/ pus mo g.yas btsugs lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur brlar brten zhes snang*/ don 'og sgo stan la ma reg par rkang mthil gnyis sbyar la rting pa'i steng du 'phongs bzhag la theb chen stan la gtad/ lag gnyis kyi mtheb chen gyis srin lag gi 'dre rtsa mnan la khu tshur bsdams pa pus mo gnyis kyi steng du bzhag la cung zhig sgur bar byas/ kha nas hā zhes rlung drag tu bsrings la lus kun bsgril zhing khong 'dar thon par bya/ yang ngal gso zhing slar yang de 'dra lan gnyis te gsum bya/ de nas/ ci bder 'dug pa'i rnal 'byor pas// bya lam bza' zhing drag por rngubs// ji srid lto ba ma khengs pa// de srid tshod dang sbyar zhing bya// zhes pas lus gang bde bar bsdad nas/ sems kyis khams gsum gyi nam mkha' sngo me re re byung nas lus sngo mer gyis gang bar bsams la/ 'og rlung cung zhig 'then/ kha nas rlung sgra bcas su hub kyis drangs shing lto ba ltir gyis khengs pa dang*/ steng rlung mnan te rlung kha sbyar/ mi thub tsa na dal bus btang*/ bsgom bya'i dngos gzhi yin pas lan gang mang bya/ yang skabs 'gar sgom pa sogs byung na/ rang gi mdun 'dom gang gi nam mkhar grub thob dza hā bhīr sku mdog smug nag zhabs gnyis mthil sbyar ba/ phyag gnyis pus mo'i steng du sa gnon gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa zla ba nya gang ba'i rgyab yol can/ sku'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas bdud rtsi dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa grub pa'i dngul chu lta bu zil pa phrom phrom yod par bsams la/ kha nas rlung rngubs pas bdud rtsi thams cad skya nur nur byung*/

lus kyi nang thams cad 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis mer gyis gang*/ 'chi ba med pa'i tshe/ rgud pa med pa'i lang tsho/ rtag brtan gzhom gzhig dang bral ba rdo rje'i lus su gyur cing lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyang bdud rtsi'i zil pa phrom phrom yod par bsams la rlung 'dzin pa lan 'ga' re bya/ rjes las sbyor ni/ sgo bzhi bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang*// dgu phrugs 'khrul 'khor sbyor ba yis// mgo bo'i nad rnams kun byang zhing*// mig gi rab rib mtha' dag sel// de bzhin dbang po gzhan la'o// zhes pa'i don lag pa'i mtheb chen gnyis kyis rna ba gnyis/ mdzub mo gnyis kyis mig gnyis/ gung mos sna gnyis/ srin lag gnyis dang mthe'u chung gnyis kyis kha ste sgo bzhi bkag cing rlung bzung nas/ g.yas su lan gsum/ g.yon du lan gsum/ yang g.yas su gsum re bskor/ mig lta bu la mtshon na ling tog rab rib sogs mig nad thams cad du ba'i rnam pas mig nang nas 'thon zhing rlung gis ded par bsams la mig phye/ gzhan rnams ma bsal bar bzhag ma thub na bsal la sna nas dal bus btang*/ des gzhan la yang bgres shes par bya'o// de ltar bsgoms pa'i phan yon ni gzhung las/ 'di ltar brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pa// nad kyi rnam pa kun byang zhing*// zag med bde ba rab rgyas nas// 'chi med go 'phang nges par 'thob// ces dang*/ bhū rlung 'di nyid bdun phrag gsum// zas gzhan spangs te bsgom par bya// de nas rim gyis zla ba drug /bsgoms na 'chi med 'grub bo gsungs// kho bo'i bla ma nub phyogs pas// 'di nyid zla ba drug bsgoms pas// me dang chu yis mi gnod pa'i// rdzu 'phrul mchog la mnga' brnyes gyur// kho bo blo zhan brtson 'grus dman// 'on kyang zhag bdun nyams blangs pas// yid ches ngo mtshar mang du byung*// zhes gsungs pa ltar thog mar zhag bdun lta bur zas skom gyi spros pa bcad la thun grangs dang thun tshad med par bsgoms pas nad thams cad byang ba ni nyams su myong*/

de nas goms par byas nas zla drug btang na nges par 'chi med kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro// zhes grub thob dza hā bhīr nas brgyud pa'i tshe sgrub kyi nyams khrid 'di nyid drin can rdo rje 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel gyis bka' gnang ba ltar lha rigs 'a zha'i ban+de 'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug rgyal mtshan rab brtan gyis rje bla ma'i bzhugs gnas gro mo lung du shugs 'byung mgyogs bris su sbyar ba 'dis kyang sems can thams cad 'chi med kyi go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /'di nyid nyams khrid lung dang bcas pa legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ pad+ma saṃ bhā wa/ ma hā sid+dhi dza hā bhīr/ bh+ra ma nā tha/ ma ṇi ka nā tha/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug 'phags mchog byams pa skal bzang*/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag zhwa lu pa/ rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po/ rig 'dzin pad+ma phrin las/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar pa legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ rig 'dzin phyogs las rnam rgyal/ mchog sprul rin po che byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po// des bdag la stsal ba'o// ༈ /dza bīr gyi rlung khrid 'ja' lus mngon gyur zhes bya ba bzhugs// na mo gu ru dza hā bī rā ya/ gang gi bka' drin bdag la nod pa yis// snying mun sel ba'i sgron me rab sbar nas// stong gsum gsal mdzad rje btsun bla na med// grub mchog blo bzang byams par gus par 'dud// rgya gar shar phyogs grub chen dza bīr nas// rim par brgyud pa'i rlung khrid dag snang ma'i// nyams len mdo tsam 'dri bar byed pa la// bka' srung drang srong brgyad kyis gnang ba stsol// nges 'byung lhag bsam sngon song rnal 'byor pa// tshe 'di blos btang rlung khrid zab mo'i don// skal ldan 'ga' la phan phyir lhag bsam gyis// zab mo rlung gi bcud len nyams khrid bshad// de la sbyor dngos mjug gsum las/

dang po sbyor ba ni/ rang nyid gang du 'dug pa'i gnas khang de nyid kyang rang gar grub pa ma yin pa ngo bo pad+ma bkod pa'am bde ba can yin pa la/ rnam pa sa chu me rlung nam mkha' lnga'i bcud rim bzhin ser dkar dmar ljang sngo ba'i 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i rang bzhin du bsam/ rang yang tha mal du gnas pa ma yin par rang lus 'ja' tshon gyi rang bzhin rnam snang gi chos bdun du bcas pa'i lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma kha dog sngon po bai ḍūr+ya lta bu khyad chos bzhi ldan/ rtsa rtse rbad kyis bcad pa/ sba mkhar 'bring po tsam/ yar sna tshangs bug dang mar sna gsang gnas su zug pa/ g.yas g.yon du rim pa ltar ro rkyang gnyis kha dog dkar dmar mda' smyug tsam gyi yar sna rna ba gnyis su sbal pa'i kha gdangs pa lta bu/ mar sna dbu mar zug pa yi ge cha lta bu/ rtsa de gsum lus kyi ka ba'i tshul du gnas pa/ 'ja' tshon sna lngar bsgoms kyang chog gzhan rgyab rtsa nyi khri chig stong rgal tshigs re gdung ma rgyug pa'i dral ma'i tshul du yod pa'am/ yang na rtsa phran nyi khri chig stong gro sogs 'bring po tsam gyi rtsa ba rnams 'khor lo lnga'i gnas rnams su zug pa/ rtse mo nas ba spu nyi khri chig stong skyes pa rnams kyang 'ja' tshon lnga'i rang bzhin nam/ yang na 'ja' dkar po'i rang bzhin gdung ma la rgyug pa'i dral ma'i tshul du bsam/ rgyas par spro na rtsa 'khor phran rags pa rnams bla med ltar gsal btab/ skyabs yul dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor lhan cig bskyed pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor khri snyan sā le'i pags pa'i steng du/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po grub thob dza hā bī ra'i rnam pa can 'phongs kyis tshangs bug dang*/ zhabs rting gnyis kyis ro rkyang gnyis kyi kha bkag pa 'ja' tshon gyi rnam par bzhugs pa'i phyag gnyis mdzod spur thal mo sbyor ba/ ang rag dang sgom thag dmar po/ na bza' dkar po/

dbu skra mthing ga thor cog phyed bcings byas pa/ khri snyan gyi pags pa gnyis bltabs byas pa phrag pa g.yon du bkal ba'i mgo bos nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol ba/ de thams cad kyang 'ja'i rang bzhin can/ zhal nas khri snyan gyi rā dung 'bud pa'i sgra las/ dza bī ra'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi chos kyi phyogs bcur sgrogs par bsam/ de'i dbu gtsug tu khri snyan gyi pags pa'i steng du mchog sprul rin po che blo gsal bstan skyong*/ de'i dbu gtsug gi gdan steng du rje btsun 'chi med grub pa'i dbang mo dpal ldan bzang mo nas/ ma hā nā tha'i bar bla ma thams cad grub thob dza hā bī ra'i rnam pa can dang*/ yang na rtsa ba'i bla ma nas rgyal dbang rat+na'i bar phal cher rab byung gi rnam pa can chos gos gsum dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta badz+ra nā tha/ grub chen dza hā bī ra/ grub chen ma hā nā tha gsum grub thob kyi rnam pa can ang rag sgom thag sogs gsol ba rnams tho brtsegs/ ma hā nā tha'i spyi bor pad+ma 'dab ma stong ldan nyi zla'i steng du sprul sku mtsho skyes rdo rje za hor gyi cha lugs 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i rang bzhin can/ de'i spyi bor pad zla'i steng du longs sku spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i rnam pa can sku mdog gangs ri ltar dkar ba/ de'i spyi bor pad zla'i steng du chos sku snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog bye ru'i mdog 'dra ba phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag can rnams gsal bar bsgom zhing*/ rang gi g.yas g.yon du tshe 'di'i pha mas thog drangs pa'i ma gyur sems can thams cad kyang 'ja' lus kyi rang bzhin du bsams nas 'ja' lus mkha' spyod sogs 'dod yul byas te/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi dang*/ spro na yan lag bdun pa dang maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ bdag sogs 'gro ba sems can rnams// bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// dam chos rnams la skyabs su mchi// dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi// shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pas// brtson pas sems can don du bdag

/sangs rgyas mdun du gnas byas nas// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi// sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /ces lan bdun nam gsum mam gcig brjod/ bla ma dkon mchog rnam gsum la// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig ltung bshags// dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskul// gsol 'debs dge tshogs byang chen bsngo// phyi nang snod bcud longs spyod rnams// dkon mchog gsum la gus pas 'bul// rang gzhan tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs shing*// yang dag 'ja' lus myur thob shog /de nas dbyangs dang bcas pas gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ na mo/ ka dag rang byung nyid kyi pho brang du// chos sku 'od mi 'gyur la gsol ba 'debs// phung po lhag med 'ja' lus grub pa dang*// tshe 'dir mkha' spyod bgrod par byin gyis rlobs// tshig 'og ma gnyis kun la 'gre/ lhun grub bde ba chen po'i pho brang du// longs sku spyan ras gzigs la= phung po= tshe 'dir= /thugs rje phyogs lhung bral ba'i pho brang du// sprul sku mtsho skyes rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs/ phung po= tshe 'dir= /'khrul pa'i mtshan ma rang grol pho brang du// ma hā nā tha'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// phung po= tshe 'dir= /rtsa gsum bde ba chen po'i pho brang du// grub chen dza hā bī ra la gsol ba 'debs// phung po= tshe 'dir= /sku dang ye shes mthar phyin pho brang du// badz+ra nā tha'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// phung po= tshe 'dir= /gzho stod te sgro brag gi ri khrod du// rgyal dbang rat+na'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// phung po= tshe 'dir= /gnas chen zab phu lung gi pho brang du// rdzogs chen sangs rgyas tshul khrims la gsol ba 'debs// phung po= tshe 'dir= /mkha' khyab bsam gtan gling gi dgon pa ru// mkhas mchog 'od gsal rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs// phung po=

tshe 'dir= /gang shar bde ba chen po'i pho brang du// ras chen chos rgyal lhun grub la gsol ba 'debs// phung po= tshe 'dir= /spyi bo bde ba chen po'i pho brang du// byams mgon tshul khrims grags pa la gsol ba 'debs// phung po= tshe 'dir= /snying ga chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du// 'dren mchog sangs rgyas shes rab la gsol ba 'debs// phung po= tshe 'dir= /lte ba sprul pa'i sku yi pho brang du// 'jam dbyangs byams pa kun dga' la gsol ba 'debs// phung po= tshe 'dir= /lhun grub sku gsum 'dus pa'i pho brang du// 'dren mchog blo bzang chos rgyan la gsol ba 'debs// phung po= tshe 'dir= /dben gnas byang chub chen po'i pho brang du// 'dren mchog lha pa'i mtshan can la gsol ba 'debs// phung po= tshe 'dir= /kha skong ni/ byang chen thar pa chen po'i ri khrod du// mkhas grub blo bzang bstan 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs// phung po= tshe 'dir= /yang dben bsam gtan sgang ba'i gzim spyil du// bshes gnyen ye shes rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs// phung po= tshe 'dir= /dga' lung 'chi med grub pa'i dben gnas su// rje btsun dpal ldan bzang mo la gsol ba 'debs// phung po= tshe 'dir= /mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas zhwa lu ri phug tu// rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong la gsol ba 'debs// phung po= tshe 'dir= /ris med mkhas grub 'du ba'i bsti gnas su// 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po la gsol ba 'debs// phung po= tshe 'dir= /bkod pa byang chub sems kyi pho brang du// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// phung po= tshe 'dir= /gsang gnas bde ba rgyas pa'i pho brang du// bka' srung drang srong sde brgyad la gsol ba 'debs// phung po lhag med 'ja' lus 'grub pa dang*// tshe 'dir mkha' spyod bgrod par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ 'od dpag med nas re re bzhin rim par 'ja'i rang bzhin rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar thim par dmigs nas 'jog la/

de nas/ na mo dza hā bī ra/ zhes pa'i sngags bdun nam/ nyer gcig brjod nas/ lag pa g.yon pa'i srin mdzub kyis lce thog nas mchil ma blangs pa smin mtshams su thig le byas pas/ de khri snyan sā le'i pags par gyur pa'i steng du dza bī ra mtheb tshon gang ba bzhes pa gcig bskyed pa'am/ phra ba nas rdog tsam zhig bzhengs stabs kyis bzhugs pa des gegs sel zhing*/ zas kyi dngos grub ster bar bsam mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdun/ zas su za ba/ gos su gyon pa/ gdan du 'ding ba/ tshe bsring ba/ byin rlabs dbang bzhi len tshul/ skom du btung ba/ gegs sel ba rnams so// dang po zas su za ba la gnyis te/ rlung zhi ba sgra med du za ba dang*/ drag po sgra bcas su za ba'o// dang po rlung zhi ba sgra med du za ba ni/ phyi'i 'byung ba lnga'i bcud rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i rang bzhin du gsal ba/ nang gi rlung gis 'then nas rang gi khar rngubs te za ba dang*/ gnyis pa rlung drag por za ba na/ mgrin pa cung zad btegs nas kha gdangs pas g.yon nas g.yas su bskor nas lan gsum tsam hab hab byas te 'gram phug bstigs nas mchil ma dang lhan du ldig bskyur bya zhing cung zad re dgang bas lus kyi nang thams cad 'ja' tshon gyis khrig mer te gang bar bsam zhing*/ bcud rnams rlung 'ja' tshon sna lnga za ba'i skabs ltar la zas med pas chog par byed/ ci ste mchog na ja phor gang dos brid/ bza' bca' btung ba dang snang ba thams cad kyang 'jar bsgom/ 'ja'i mtshan nyid kyang gong du bstan pa ltar gong 'og thams cad du'o// gnyis pa gos su gyon pa ni/ rlung sngar ltar zos pas lus nang du ma shong bar ro rkyang gsum gyi kha nas thon pas bla ma dza hā bī ra 'dom gang tsam 'phags nas 'ja'i steng du bzhugs/ de nas kyang lus kyi nang du ma shor bar rtsa phran nyi khri chig stong gi kha dang khyad par spyi bo nas lud pa bde drod dang bcas pa lus la 'ja' dgu brtsegs kyi gos khra shig shig g.yogs pas bde drod 'bar bar bsam zhing*/

gos thams cad kyang 'ja' tshon du bsgom mo// gsum pa gdan du 'ding ba ni/ rlung sngar ltar zos pas lus nang du ma shong bar 'og sgo gnyis dang*/ lus smad kyi ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas sdom gyi thag pa ltar/ shin tu phra ba 'ja'i rnam par 'phros pa'i rtse mo lcags kyu lta bus 'og gzhi dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi nas 'a byung ba lnga'i bcud rnams 'ja' sna lnga'i rang bzhin du bsdus pas/ dbyar dus sa rlangs rgyas pa ltar stong gsum gang ba de thams cad rim gyis gling bzhi dang*/ 'dzam gling dang*/ yul phyogs gnas khang rnams su 'dril/ mthar rang gi mal khengs pas lus kyi nu ma man btums nas lus la bde drod 'bar bar bsam zhing*/ gdan thams cad 'jar bsgom/ bzhi pa tshe bsring ba nam mkha' zas su za ba ni/ nam mkha' la lta stangs gtad de/ hūm̐ zhes brjod nas rlung zos pas 'dzam gling gi nam mkha'i khams thams cad 'ja' baiḍūr+ya'i mdog lta bu byung ba mdun gyi nam mkhar hūm̐ mthing kha mkhyud gang tsam du gyur pa rlung zhabs gcod pa dang mnyam du byung bas tshe'i bdud rtsi sngon po zhu nas lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin thob par bsam mo// lnga pa byin rlabs dbang bzhi len tshul ni/ rlung sngar ltar zos pas lus nas 'ja' tshon mchod sprin gyi rnam pa phyogs bcur 'phros/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad mnyes par byas/ de rnams kyi gnas lnga nas ye shes lnga 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs pa rang gi gnas lngar thim pas sgrib bzhi dag cing dbang bzhi thob nas sku bzhi thob pa'i mos pa ci brtan bya'o// drug pa skom du btung ba ni/ snang ba thams cad chur bsgom zhing*/ khyad par brag g.yang mthon po'i chu shin tu bsil ba shang sgra dang bcas pa nam mkha' nas byung bar bsam zhing*/ rlung so la bshad nas skom dus su btung ba'o// bdun pa gegs sel ba ni/ sgra med zhi bar za skabs/

lus gnad ma nges/ 'phong cung zad btegs mgul pa gyen la brkyangs nas zos pas/ drag por zos pa'i gegs dmar thom sogs sel/ hab zas kyi skabs/ lus gnad gong ltar la hab ces rbad kyis bcad nas za zhing brang la khu tshur byas pas rlung stod du phyur ba dang*/ 'tshang ba sel lo// btsan thabs su za skabs/ ya rkan gyi steng nas 'bebs pa dang*/ mgrin pa bkug nas 'degs pa gnyis kyis ngal dub sel ba'o// sgregs skyugs gnon zhing 'og rlung mi btang ba gnad che/ 'di rnams gegs sel yin zhing*/ dngos gzhi drag zas rang la 'bad do// 'di'i skabs 'gro 'dug dgos dus 'ja' dkar po'i steng du 'gro ba'i dmigs pa byed/ snga thun la thog mar ngag mi btang bar rlung ro dgu phrugs su 'bud cing*/ dge sems dang ldan pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi nas bzung thun drug gi skabs so so'i dmigs pa dang*/ rlung zas gnyis la 'bad pa gal shin tu che/ thun tha mar nyal bar phyogs pa dang*/ spyi bo'i bla ma smin mtshams kyi grub chen dza bī ra la bstims zhing ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag rlung de nyid bum pa can du 'dzin na bla ma rnams 'ja' tshon gyi rnam par rang la thim nas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du 'dres/ 'ja' lus phyi gsal nang gsal du mnyam par bzhag bdag lus dza hā bīr tu gsal ba'i lus nang du/ rtsa dbu ma yar rtse spyi bor zug pa mar sna lte 'og gnyer po cher zug pa mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa/ de yang til gyi mar me ltar gsal ba/ rgya skyegs kyi khu ba ltar dmar ba/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar srab pa/ chu shing gi sdong po ltar drang ba/ de yang rta rnga tsam nas mda' smyug tsam/ sba lcag tsam/ lus ril po dbu ma/ de rgya je cher song*/ nam mkhas gar khyab dbu mas khyab par bsam/ slar yang je phra la song*/ sba lcag tsam du gsal/ g.yas su ro ma dmar po yar sna sna bug g.yas la zug pa dang*/

g.yon ma rkyang ma dkar mo yar sna sna bug g.yon la zug pa/ gnyis ka'i mar sna dbu ma'i mar snar zug pa/ de yang rtsa gsum gyi rtsa ba yi ge cha'i 'phongs lta bu'o// rtsa gsum po lus kyi ka ba'i tshul du gnas pa'o// de ltar gnas pa'i rtsa dbu ma la mkhar btsal te snying khar chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis/ mgrin par brgyad gnyis bcu drug spyi bor sum brgya drug cu/ lte bar drug cu rtsa bzhi/ gsang gnas nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ rtsa 'khor de rnams gdugs kyi rtsibs ma ltar gsal ba'o// de thams cad kyang dbu ma'i mtshan nyid ltar gsal ba'o// dbu ma de'i nang du mar snar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ mi shigs pa'i a thung skra rtse tsam dbu ma'i nang du tshud pa me 'od phrom phrom 'bar ba la shes pa gtad/ de'i ngang nas rlung ro dgu phrugs su 'bud cing*/ de nas rlung nang du rngub ste/ lte 'og tu kha sbyar bzung ngo*// dmigs pa a thung me 'od 'phro ba la gtad/ 'og rlung bskum/ rlung mi thub pa dang rngub chung byed cing dal bus sna nas btang*/ de la goms pa dang me lte 'og tu 'bar ba la dmigs pa gcig de nas snying kha mgrin pa rnams re re la dmigs pa re re byed/ de dang bstun nas rngub chung re bsnan te bsgom/ lag gi mdzub mo bsnol te pus mor 'khyud la sprugs par bya'o// pho ba bskor ba brgya rtsa re yang bya/ mgo bo g.yas g.yon gdugs ltar bskor/ g.yas g.yon phyogs bzhi dag la 'phang*// lag pa g.yas g.yon res mos 'phang*// ro stod g.yas g.yon res mos gcud// smad ldem rkang pa res mos bshad// de ltar brtson 'grus drag pos 'bad// yang rlung rngub ste lus kyi nang thams cad mes gang*/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad me stag phrom phrom la shes pa gtad nas rlung bsgom/ de nas gang mthong gi sa dang nam mkha' kun mes gang bar bsam ste rlung drag por dgang*/ rngub chung lnga la brdab sprugs re re'am gsum gsum byed/

mthar drag por bus/ rjes la 'jam rlung gis kha brgyan no// de nas 'khrul 'khor rnams la 'bad/ des lus kyi rtsa mdud grol bas lus la bde drod skye'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi smon gnas su gyur pa 'grub cing de las byung ba'i dge ba rnams 'dun pa drag pos bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dza hā bī ra 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /smon lam ni/ 'tsho ba'i rgyun bcad rlung sbyor gyis// ma rig 'khrul pa dag gyur te// rtsa gsum dbang bsgyur 'ja' lus sku// tshe 'dir mngon du 'gyur bar shog /shis brjod ni/ bde stong chos nyid 'gyur med thugs// grags stong rgyun chad med pa'i gsung*// snang stong gsal 'grib med pa'i sku// 'du 'bral med pa'i bkra shis shog /'di ltar gdams pa 'di thog mar zhag bdun nges par bya zhing*/ phyi nas ja sogs med par zhag brgya gcig yan nges med gang thub la 'bad cing*/ dus rgyun par yang bza' btung byed dus dang*/ dge sbyor gyi thun mtshams thams cad du zos pa'i lag rjes su rab 'ja' lus mngon du 'gyur ba dang*/ de min yang thug pa rtsam pa sbangs nas lo dang tshe hril po ba'i nyams len bya gsungs so// phan yon ni/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas/ gnas skabs su'ang dge sbyor 'grib rkyen gyi dkor spyi dang*/ khyad par log 'tsho/ gshin zas dad zas sogs kyi nyes pa khegs shing*/ dka' thub byas pas las sgrib dpag med 'dzad cing zas sogs tshe 'di'i dbang du mi 'gro ba dang*/ rang gi ston pa nas gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar dang mthun pas gdung 'tshob par yang 'gro ba sogs phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab bo// 'di zhag bdun phrag gcig thengs pas yi dwags kyi skye sgo gcod par o rgyan gyi bro bor zhing*/ gnyis pa btang bas rlung gi gegs sel/ gsum pa btang bas rlung gi mdangs rnyed/

mang du btang bas grub chen dza hā bī ra ltar 'ja' lus brnyes pa la sogs pa'i phan yon shin tu che zhing*/ mthar thug rnam mkhyen gyi go 'phang myur du ster bas tshe blos btang nas lag rjes thon pa gal che'o// gdams pa 'di tshe blos btang dang*/ dbang bzhi thob pa la ma gtogs gzhan la byin na/ drang srong chen po rā hu la sogs gza' chen brgyad la bcol gtad yod pa lags pas/ rang srog la gces spras gal che'o// zur sogs ma dag lhag chad byung ba rnams// rin chen bla ma mchog dang lcam dral dang*// bka' srung drang srong sde brgyad la sogs pa'i// bshags yul ji snyed mchis pas bzod par gsol// zhes dza bīr kyi rlung khrid bcud len 'ja' lus mngon gyur zhes pa 'di ni lho spyan lung gi sa'i char/ dpal mchog gi pho brang sgrub gnas chen po 'brog shel stod ri bo cher rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po slar yang ngur smrig gi rnam par rol pa bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po blo bzang byams pa phun tshogs mtshan can gyi bka' 'bangs tha shal ba lha btsun ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis zin bris btab pa dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
